record.reason: 本文を確認したが、対象系統との接続またはLLM推論効率の実証が弱く、一般化可能性を確認できない。ChatRetriever adapts dense retrieval for conversational context and evaluates retrieval/QA quality. It does not demonstrate a concrete LLM serving memory or inference-cost improvement; relation to inference systems is weak.
record.title: ChatRetriever: Adapting Large Language Models for Generalized and Robust Conversational Dense Retrieval
